title: One percent
logline: Small daily changes compound: 1% better for a year is ~38×, 1% worse is ~0.03×.
audience: Anyone scrolling a feed at work — one idea, stated precisely, in under 30 seconds.

music.prompt: Minimal electronic, soft plucked synth arpeggio, warm sub, light shaker

beats.vo: Get one percent better every day.
beats.visual: A tall '1%' lands on 'one percent'. A tiny day counter starts ticking.

beats.vo: After a year, you're not three hundred sixty-five percent better.
beats.visual: '365%' appears and is struck through on 'not'.
A curve bends upward; the counter climbs from 1.00× to 37.8× as the line draws.

beats.vo: One percent worse each day? <short pause> You end the year near zero.
beats.visual: A second, falling curve in rust; its counter sinks to 0.03×.
Both numbers side by side: 37.8× and 0.03×. Formula footnote.
